samples.xml_description:
<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Pulse detector. Detects 0->1->0 transitions in data_in.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset.</input>
        <input id="data_in">Data input.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Pulse output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="initial_state">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="first_one">First one detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="second_zero">Second zero detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="last_pulse">Last pulse detected.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state">Current state.</reg>
        <wire id="next_state">Next state.</wire>
        <always @(*) begin : fsm_next_state
            case(state)
                initial_state: next_state = data_in ? first_one : initial_state;
                first_one:     next_state = ~data_in ? second_zero : first_one;
                second_zero:   next_state = data_in ? last_pulse : initial_state;
                last_pulse:    next_state = data_in ? first_one : initial_state;
            endcase
        end
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin : state_reg_update
            if(~rst_n) begin
                state <= initial_state;
            end else begin
                state <= next_state;
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <assign id="data_out" description="Set data_out to 1 at the last cycle of a pulse. Else, set it to 0.">data_out = state == last_pulse;</assign>
    </logic_description>
</module>
